chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya and Muhammad ibn Abdullah from Abdullah ibn Ja'far, that he wrote to Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him):

It has been reported from the two Truthful Ones (peace be upon them) that: 'Circumcise your children on the seventh day to purify them, and indeed the earth resounds with noise to Allah from the urine of the uncircumcised.' And I, may I be your ransom, said: The surgeons of our city are not skilled in that, and they do not circumcise him on the seventh day. And among us is a Jewish surgeon, so is it permissible for the Jew to circumcise the children of the Muslims or not, if Allah wills?
So he (peace be upon him) signed: 'The Sunnah is on the seventh day, therefore do not oppose the Sunnah, if Allah wills.'
ai.seo_question: When should a Muslim boy be circumcised according to Shia hadith, and is it permissible for a Jew to perform the procedure?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the seventh day as the normative time for male circumcision, linking it to ritual purity and the concept of the earth 'groaning' from the urine of the uncircumcised. It further clarifies the permissibility of non-Muslims, specifically Jews, performing the procedure for Muslims, affirming that the specific practitioner does not invalidate the established Sunnah of the seventh day.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya and Muhammad Bin Abdullah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abdullah son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> who wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>

that it has been reported from the two truthful ones (5<sup>th</sup> and 6<sup>th</sup> Imams<sup>asws</sup>) that: ‘Circumcise your children on the seventh day purifying them, and that the earth resounds with noise to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from the urine of the uncircumcised; and there are no surgeons in our city skillful with that, and they (the people) are not circumcising on the seventh day, and among us is a Jewish surgeon, so is it allowed for the Jew that he circumcises the children of the Muslims or not, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing?’
So he<sup>asws</sup> signed: ‘The Sunnah is on the seventh day, therefore you should not oppose the Sunnah, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya and Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah have narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Ja‘far who has said the following: “I once wrote to abu Muhammad, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, that it is narrated from the two truthful Imam,

‘Alayhim al-Salam, who have said, ’Circumcise your children on the seventh day from their birth; the earth cries before Allah because of the urine of an uncircumcised person.’ I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, people performing circumcision in our city are not very knowledgeable and they do not do it on the seventh day but there is a Jewish person; if it is permissible for a Jewish person to circumcise children of Muslims or not by the will of Allah.
He (the Imam) signed the answer that said, ’It is of Sunnah to circumcise on the seventh day, so do not oppose the Sunnah by the will of Allah.’”
